raidSayLines.line: 📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
Something moves out there — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline.
The dog-shaped silence at the treeline stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
It followed you. The dog-shaped silence at the treeline is here.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)
⚔️ Werner stood down the dog-shaped silence at the treeline and kept walking — 3 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
⚔️ Nikolai stared down the dog-shaped silence at the treeline and it backed off — 0 rounds, not a scratch on them. It's still out there, somewhere.

🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (a line of ducks, walking in perfect formation. In the dark. That is not normal duck behavior., a dog-shaped silence at the treeline, a dog-shaped silence at the treeline, a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong, a red moon rising between the trees, breathing) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

🚨 a line of ducks, walking in perfect formation. In the dark.
